description: Outline of the visible interactive elements on the current page, each with a ref (e1, e2…), nested only under what identifies it: landmarks, sections by heading, tables (column / row), list items. Pick the element you need, then pass its ref to cor_inspect. Markers: ✓id test attribute, +N hidden lookalikes, [disabled]/[checked]/[expanded]/[selected], [unstable id]; "clickable" is an element with no role that the page makes clickable (cursor: pointer). Take a new snapshot after any navigation or act call — earlier refs expire. On a large page it answers with a region index (each region's controls, the named ones first); full: true lists every control.

full.description: The whole outline even on a large page, instead of the region index.

within.description: Show one region in full instead — every line of text, prices and labels included. A ref (its region: the card, row, column or section that identifies it) or a region's name (a heading, a landmark label, a list item or table row's text). A name matching several regions returns the choices.

name: cor_snapshot
title: List interactive elements
